articles.title: Crypto platform operator gets 15-year prison sentence in South Korea due to $50 million scam
articles.snippet: A South Korean court sentenced the head of centralized finance (CeFi) lender Delio to 15 years in prison for embezzling digital assets from more than 1,100 customers.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley's infrastructure partner Zerohash rebuffed in pitch to be U.S. trust bank
articles.snippet: Zerohash, which handles crypto plumbing for Morgan Stanley's E*Trade, said it's planning on re-filing and hoping for a swift resolution.

articles.title: Public Bitcoin miners cut hashrate 13.4% as AI infrastructure revenue grows
articles.snippet: AI and HPC are reshaping mining economics as operators repurpose power and data centers, while a smaller group of miners continues to expand Bitcoin capacity.

articles.title: Bullish shares jump 10% as Q2 adjusted EBITDA more than triples
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator’s shares gained around 10% as adjusted EBITDA more than tripled and subscription and services revenue hit a record high.

articles.title: Bitmine’s $257M annualized staking income ‘fills’ operational gaps, share buybacks: analysts
articles.snippet: Bitmine’s Ether staking revenue is an important financial buffer that fills financial gaps and provides recurring revenue streams beyond Ether’s price appreciation, analysts told Cointelegraph.
